tidbit: Did you know… about 11,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Siemens and NVIDIA launch a solution cutting engineering work by 85% and costs by 20%. Reported by 手机新浪网: the partners advance autonomous manufacturing at German factories.
Anthropic proposes a bill to block models risking 50+ deaths or $1B damage. Reported by Insurance Journal: the proposal pitches safety guardrails to lawmakers.
The U.S. DHS bans DeepSeek products in civilian agencies over data transfer risks. Reported by Central Oregon Daily: the government moves to protect agency systems.
Caveat AI Pro offers 40 monthly reviews for $89.99 to verify answers across major platforms. Reported by PCMag: the fact-checking companion works with ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
IN-COM connects artificial intelligence tools to 5.7B lines of mainframe code via MCP. Reported by EIN Presswire: the platform links ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini and Grok to legacy systems.
Free every hour.
